title: The chosen completed open exchange is normalized by the strict exchange
statement: Let d be an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and let (v:U'→U,j':U'→T',j:U→T,g:T'→T) be a cartesian open square with j quasi-compact [def-cbc-open-immersion-square]. Fix a finite generating tuple of the adic ideal, K intrinsically derived complete, and j!K intrinsically derived complete [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion]. Let R_V denote the strict derived quotient reduction, J_j the actual completed-ring open extension, and L_V its completed-ring derived inverse limit [def-cbc-completed-open-scalar-quotient-interface]. Form omega_K by completedTowerPullback(g) of the canonical quotient/open source comparison followed by the simultaneous strict exchange [def-cbc-completed-strict-open-exchange]. Transport it to theta_K : d.towerPull(g)(R_T(j!K)) → J_j'(d.towerPull(v)(R_U K)) by precomposing the inverse cbcDatumTowerTransport at g and postcomposing J_j' of the forward transport at v [def-cbc-completed-pullback-counit-transport]. The specified cbcDatumCompletedExchange [lem-cbc-completed-extension-zero-comparison], followed by cbcRealizationLimitMap(J_j') at d.towerPull(v)(R_U K), equals L_T'(theta_K). This equality of completed-ring derived morphisms retains the ordinary-to-completed unit; it involves no constant-scalar restriction or constant-coefficient beta comparison.

theorem completedOpenExchangeLimitNormalization [QuasiCompact j]
    (sq : OpenImmersionSquare v j' j g)
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = d.ideal)
    (K : (cbcCompleteProperty d U r a ha).FullSubcategory)
    (_hJK : cbcCompleteProperty d T r a ha
      ((cbcDerivedOpenShriek d j inferInstance).obj K.obj)) :
    (cbcDatumCompletedExchange d sq r a ha).app K ≫
        (cbcRealizationLimitMap (cbcOpenShriek d j' inferInstance)).app
          ((d.towerPull v).obj ((completedReductionTower U d).obj K.obj)) =
      (completedRlim T' (d.completedRing T')).map
        ((cbcDatumTowerTransport d g).inv.app
            ((completedReductionTower T d).obj
              ((cbcDerivedOpenShriek d j inferInstance).obj K.obj)) ≫
          ((completedTowerPullback g d).map (cbcRealizationReduction d j K.obj).hom ≫
            (cbcReductionStrictExchange d sq).hom.app K.obj) ≫
          (cbcRealizationJ d j').map
            ((cbcDatumTowerTransport d v).hom.app
              ((completedReductionTower U d).obj K.obj)))
